title: fix(objectql): an uninstalled package no longer reads as read-only until a restart
body:
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEcGxYY8iXRzD52FM7U9N4o)_ Fixes #30215 Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/objectql`'s exported `SchemaRegistry` gains the public method `onPackageUninstalled(listener)`, which returns its unsubscribe. Nothing is refused that was accepted before. Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么：** 注册表 `uninstallPackage` 撤下一个包后，向订阅者宣告一次；引擎在构造时订阅，从自己的 `manifests` 表里删掉该包 id。于是卸载答 200 之后，同一实例上该 id 不再被当成代码包，`ensure-customization` 答 `writable: true`。 - **为什么改：** 以前只有 `registerApp` 往 `manifests` 写，没有任何卸载门删它；ADR-0070 的 `isWritablePackage` 先读这张表，所以卸载过的包（例如旧运行时当代码装的 `.custom` 配对包，PR #30207 现在叫管理员去卸）一直只读，直到重启，而卸载答复只说「已从运行内核撤下」。 - **风险与回滚：** 只在卸载成功、包记录已删之后才删 `manifests` 项；被拒的卸载（ADR-0029 有扩展者）什么都不动（有 pin）；同 id 重装照旧写回。订阅者抛错不会把已完成的卸载变成拒绝，只记一条 `error` 日志。回滚即撤 PR。 - **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `onPackageUninstalled` / `announcePackageUninstalled` 与 `uninstallPackage` 末尾一行；`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 构造函数里的订阅一行；`packages/objectql/src/registry-module-mock.ts` 新增的替身成员。 - **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local src/engine-uninstall-forgets-manifest.test.ts`，预期 7 条全过。 - **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。 ## What changes **The gap.** `ObjectQL.registerApp` writes the package's manifest into the engine's private `manifests` map, and nothing ever deleted an entry. Every uninstall door withdraws a package through `SchemaRegistry.uninstallPackage` (the install-local DELETE, the protocol's `deletePackage`, the runtime's `DELETE /packages/:id`), and that verb never told the engine. ADR-0070's `isWritablePackage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-writability.ts`) reads `engine.manifests` first, so an uninstalled id kept reading as a booted code package, read-only, until a restart. **The fix: the state follows the registry, not the reader.** `SchemaRegistry` gains `onPackageUninstalled(listener)`, and `uninstallPackage` announces each completed uninstall as its last step, after the package record is gone. The engine subscribes in its constructor and drops its `manifests` entry. One place, so whichever door withdrew the package releases the id, and no door needs to know the engine's map exists. - A refused uninstall (ADR-0029: another package extends an object this one owns) throws before any mutation, so it announces nothing and the entry stays. - A reinstall of the same id writes the entry back (`registerApp`, unchanged). - A listener that throws is caught: the uninstall has already happened, so the door must not read it as a refusal. It is logged at `error` with the consequence and the remedy (restart), because the listener's state now disagrees with the registry while everything looks healthy. **Why not the other route the card offered (the uninstall answer says a restart is needed).** The card prefers releasing the id. Releasing it is also the only route that is right for every door: an answer-only fix would cover the install-local DELETE and leave the same stale entry behind every other caller of the registry verb. **Why not teach `isWritablePackage` to cross-check the registry.** That would be a reader skipping a stale entry, which the install-local door's own `withdrawFromRunningKernel` note rejects for the same class of defect: withdraw the registration, so every reader is right. The map's other reader (the package `defaultDatasource` lookup in `engine-secrets-and-routing.ts`) is keyed by the object's owner, which the registry already withdraws, so it was not wrong in practice; it now reads a map that agrees with the registry too. **Clause-② measured.** The seat's claim predicted `no`; it is `yes (widening)` because `SchemaRegistry` is exported from `@objectstack/objectql` and gains a public method. Nothing is narrowed: the only answer that changes is that an uninstalled id is no longer read-only on the same instance. **Test double.** Every engine now calls `onPackageUninstalled` in its constructor, so the shared `vi.mock('./registry')` factory (`registry-module-mock.ts`, used by 19 engine suites) models the member: it records the subscription and answers an unsubscribe. Without it those 19 files failed at construction (391 tests, measured on the first full run). ## Verification **Unit pins.** New `packages/objectql/src/engine-uninstall-forgets-manifest.test.ts`, 7 cases, against a real engine and its own registry, asserting through the real `isWritablePackage`: - a registered code package reads read-only, and writable once the registry uninstalls it (record gone, map entry gone); - a refused uninstall (an extended object) keeps the record and the map entry, still read-only; - a reinstall of the same id puts the entry back, read-only again; - another package's entry is untouched; - the registry announces once, after the record is gone, not for an id it does not hold, not after unsubscribe; - a throwing listener neither refuses the uninstall nor starves the next listener, and is logged at `error` once.
Ablation (twice, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; the test imports source) ``` # 1. the engine's subscription deleted (engine.ts) ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 947b0720cde1 -> 64db3051ce58 × reads a registered code package as read-only, and writable once the registry uninstalls it × puts the entry back on a reinstall of the same id Tests 2 failed | 5 passed (7) ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (947b0720cde1) and `git diff HEAD` is empty # 2. the registry's announcement deleted (registry.ts) ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 9b0443fea234 -> 8b24e75cbb5c Tests 4 failed | 3 passed (7) ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (9b0443fea234) and `git diff HEAD` is empty ``` Under ablation 1 the refusal, other-package and three registry cases stay green: they assert what the fix must not change or the registry's half alone.
End to end, two os dev --fresh showcase runtimes Fixture: a ledger entry for `com.example.showcase.custom` in `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/`, the shape an older runtime wrote when it installed a pair as code; the boot rehydrates it as code (`GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` lists it). Signed in as the dev admin. Fixed build (head with the fix, full `pnpm build`): ``` POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization (before the DELETE) 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT "Package 'com.example.showcase.custom' is installed but is not the paired customization package …" DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/com.example.showcase.custom 200 "Cached manifest removed, the package withdrawn from the running kernel, and the uninstall cleanups … ran" POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization 201 {"packageId":"com.example.showcase.custom","created":true,"writable":true} ``` Control, the same flow with the engine's subscription ablated and `@objectstack/objectql` rebuilt (`scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirmed the line absent from all 14 built files): ``` DELETE …/install-local/com.example.showcase.custom 200 (same note) POST …/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization 201 {"created":true,"writable":false} ``` That `writable: false` is the card's defect, reproduced; the restored build answers `writable: true`. Both servers were started on random ports and stopped by recorded PID; the fixture directory was removed.
Tests and gates on the final head On head `f8e6c780f`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 families; each was run with its exit code recorded to a file before any pipe, then reconciled: ``` Run reconciliation — 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. ✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 62 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3). ``` Beyond the derivation, each exit 0: - `pnpm lint` - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 549 passed (549), Tests 10870 passed (10870) - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (includes `check:test-typecheck`) - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test` (the install-local uninstall suites included) - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 541 passed (541), Tests 8619 passed, 19 skipped The CLI end-to-end uninstall suite (`package-install-local-uninstall-cleanups.integration.test.ts`, integration tier) was not run locally: it is left to CI.
## Acceptance notes - `#30217` (same install-local door) stays serial behind this card and is not touched here. - Noted, not filed: `registerApp` also indexes the manifest's `datasources` (`registerDatasourceDef`), and nothing withdraws those definitions on uninstall either. A datasource definition is keyed by its own name, not the package id, and whether a package's datasource should outlive it is a separate decision; nothing in this card measured a wrong answer from it. ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01Utp6CbfmKbpDmbzwGpfLLp)_
